critical_code_review_comments: TTS switch to emergentintegrations.llm.openai.text_to_speech.OpenAITextToSpeech is working and returns valid audio/mpeg with real MPEG frame sync (0xFFF3).
Streaming ': ping' keep-alive BEFORE LLM init is a clean fix — TTFT is now bounded by network only (~95ms observed).
asyncio.create_task on turn writes correctly decouples persistence from stream flow; no gating observed.
In-process 30s memory-tail cache is a pragmatic hot-path optimisation; consider a TTL sweeper if memory rows churn heavily.

rca_of_issue: Prior FAIL 1 root cause: hardcoded https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech which returned 'fault filter abort' 404. Fixed by switching to emergentintegrations.llm.openai.text_to_speech.OpenAITextToSpeech. Prior FAIL 2 root cause: awaited MongoDB insert + 20-doc memory fetch + LlmChat init all ran before the first byte was streamed (2.65s TTFT). Fixed by emitting ': ping' keep-alive immediately when StreamingResponse opens, moving memory tail into a 30s in-process cache, and switching turn persistence to asyncio.create_task. Verified TTFT now ~95–107ms.
